verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says founders can "track spend instantly" against budgets and "close the books in real time", and its card app lets users view spend. Its API also exposes pending (not just settled) Brex Card transaction events via real-time webhooks, which supports same-day visibility. However, nothing in the evidence documents a dashboard that breaks spend down by team, category, and merchant, and the real-time claims are marketing copy only. Missing for 10: documented spend breakdowns by team/department, category, and merchant; first-party docs describing the real-time spend dashboard; independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day visibility.
